words.example: The buddy will onboard her at the lobby and walk her to the ward.
words.exampleZh: 带教搭档会在大厅做入职对接，再送她去病区。

words.example: Remember to offboard him on Friday, including the badge and the locker.
words.exampleZh: 记得周五给他做离职交接，工牌和储物柜都要收回。

words.example: During probation she will have a check-in every two weeks.
words.exampleZh: 试用期里她每两周有一次面谈。

words.example: Bring examples of your work to the appraisal on Thursday.
words.exampleZh: 周四绩效考核时，带上几件你做过的事。

words.example: Overtime after a full day shift should be agreed in advance.
words.exampleZh: 上完白班再加班，应当事先说好。

words.example: Raise the rate limit before the morning lab rush hits.
words.exampleZh: 早间检验高峰到来之前，把速率限制调高。

words.example: The circuit breaker opened after pharmacy failed five calls in a row.
words.exampleZh: 药房连续失败五次之后，熔断器打开了。

words.example: The health endpoint returned failure, so the load balancer pulled that node.
words.exampleZh: 健康检查接口返回失败，负载均衡就把那个节点摘掉了。

words.example: The readiness probe kept the new pod out until the database answered.
words.exampleZh: 数据库有响应之前，就绪探针一直不让新容器接流量。

words.example: The liveness probe restarted the order service after it stopped answering.
words.exampleZh: 医嘱服务不再响应后，存活探针把它重启了。
